name: Sai
ability: Starts at 2 each fight. Flips 2 ↔ 4 after any Item is used.
notes: This should NOT start at 2 each fight, it should carry over its value between combats (not between dungeons eg adventure mode)

name: Healing Potion
ability: Unplayable. If you would die, discard this and Heal 3.
flow: If player HP ever equals 0, immediately Discard this item and set the player's HP to 4.

name: Victory Flask
ability: Heal 1, plus 1 for each monster Defeated
flow: On use in a fight, heal 1 + mobs_defeated, cap at 6 HP. Used up. Healing Potion still revives on death.

name: Lantern
ability: Heal 2. Keep this if you are still missing HP.
flow: Click during a fight. Heal 2, cap 6. If HP is still below 6, keep the card. If you are already at 6, heal 0 and the card is used up. Counts as an item use.
notes: Breastplate keeps if you bled. This keeps if you are still hurt after the heal.
review_note: (Tier 3) - Heal 2, then Keep this if you are still missing HP.

name: Mirror Shard
ability: Gain Block equal to the last Block you gained.
flow: Click during a fight. Gain Block equal to the last Block you gained this dungeon. If you have not gained Block yet this dungeon, the click does nothing and the card stays. Used up. Counts as an item use.
notes: Last Block is the amount from the last time you gained Block, not your current Block total.
review_note: (Tier 2) Gains block equal to the last Block you've gained. Tier 2

name: Echo Bell
ability: Becomes a copy of the last item you used.
flow: In hand this looks like the last item you used this dungeon (faint Echo icon). Click it to use that copy, then Echo is used up even if the original had Keep. If you have not used an item this dungeon, it is Unplayable.
notes: Updates when you use an item. Cube feed is not an item use. First fight of a run: Unplayable.
review_note: (Tier 3) Becomes a copy of the last item you used. (updates on item use, but keeps the echo bell icon faintly in the top right of the card).

name: Quiet Bell
ability: Remove the facing owner's unique ability.
flow: Click during a fight. That owner id loses its unique ability and formulas for the rest of this dungeon. They show printed ATK/HP like Golem. If they have no unique ability, the click does nothing and the card stays. Used up otherwise.
notes: Golem: cannot click. Bandit and other formulas fall back to the ATK/HP columns.
review_note:
(Tier 2) Remove the unique ability of the enemy.

(The enemy UI literally removes the text of their ability, and will pretend that it is an abiity-free unit (eg Golem) with the base stats of the unit. This means units with formula stats like Bandit simply turn into their base stats and are badly nerfed by this)

name: Net
ability: Reduce the facing owner's Attack by 1, 2, or 3.
flow: Click during a fight, then click 1, 2, or 3. Facing Attack drops by that much after every other formula including Commander, floors at 0, then locks for the rest of this fight. Used up.
notes: Caltrops is retired. This is the milder version, last in calc.
review_note: (Tier 1) Reduce enemy Atk by 1, 2, or 3.

name: Chain
ability: Deal Attack equal to Block you hold. Keep this item.
flow: Click during a fight. Deal Attack equal to Block you hold. You keep that Block. This item Keeps. Unplayable at 0 Block. Counts as an item use. Goblin cannot take Attack damage.
notes: Hornet and Queen still Attack after. You still hold the Block for those swings.
review_note: Attack equal to your Block, then Keep this item.

name: Counting Beads
flow: Click during a fight. Deal Attack equal to the dungeon cycle number (1, then 2, then 3, then 4, then 1). Every item use this dungeon advances that number, including this click. The cycle carries across fights and resets on the next dungeon. Two Beads share one number. Used up. Counts as an item use. Goblin cannot take Attack damage.
notes: Cube feed is not an item use, so the cycle does not advance. Anvil takes 1 from this Attack.
review_note: Alternates from 1, 2, 3, and 4 Atk damage on Item use.

name: Paci Fist
ability: If you have zero items that deal Attack, Defeat them.
flow: Click during a fight. If you hold no items that deal Attack, Defeat them. This card is not an Attack item. Unplayable if any other card in hand deals Attack. Used up when it works. Counts as an item use. Gargoyle cannot be Defeated.
notes: Holding only this works. Echo copying an Attack item counts as an Attack item. Shield alone is enough.
review_note:
(Change name to 'Paci-Fist', and icon to an open palm strike)
If you have zero items that deal Atk damage, Defeat the enemy.

name: Scythe
ability: Deal Attack equal to double your HP. If they survive, Heal 2 and Keep this item.
flow: Click during a fight. Deal Attack equal to twice your current HP. If they still have HP after that, including Goblin, Heal 2 and Keep this item. If they die, this is used up and you do not Heal. Counts as an item use.
notes: Goblin takes 0 Attack and still has HP, so Heal 2 and Keep. Anvil takes 1 from this Attack. Ogre HP is your HP, so this can still cut them.
review_note: Attack equal to half your HP (rounded down) and Heal that much. If the enemy survives, Keep this item.

name: Chaos Stone
ability: Choose other items in your hand. Each becomes a random item of that item's tier.
flow: Click during a fight, then click other items in your hand. If you hold only one other item, reroll that one. If you hold two or more, pick two. Each becomes a random item of that item's tier, with the same motion as Adventure Mode starter upgrades. This card cannot target itself. Unplayable if this is the only item in your hand. Used up. Counts as an item use.
notes: Does not deal Attack. Gargoyle petrify does not pick this. Cube feed is not this.
review_note:
(Change to 'Chaos Stone')

Choose 2 Items and replace them with random Items of the same Tier.

(This should have a similar transformation animation to how Adventure Mode dungeon starters are 'upgraded' in Tier.

name: Cursed Scroll
ability: At the start of each combat, lose 1 HP. On use, Heal your HP to up to full (6).
flow: While in inventory unused, Lose 1 HP On Spin after combat has begun. Counts as Did Lose HP for Breastplate.

name: Two-Headed Serpent
ability: My Attack drops to 0 if you use two Items this fight.
flow: When player taps 2 items this combat, ATK immediately drops to 0.
notes: If the second item is Smoke Bomb, nothing special. Smoke Bomb happens; when Serpent is spun again later it attacks again.

name: Gelatinous Cube
ability: I make you feed me one of two items.
flow: On spin, if you have 0 items, nothing. If 1, you must feed that one. If 2 or more, two random items are offered and you must feed one. The discard is not an item use. ATK/HP unchanged.
notes: Not an item use: no Kobold extra, no Echo update, no Harpy after the feed.
review_note: At the start of combat, selects 2 random items and forces the user to 'feed' them one, discarding it with no effect. (Maybe with a fun dialogue pop-up as it mocks the player and thanks the player for feeding them)

name: Gargoyle
ability: I petrify your highest Attack item until you Spin again.
flow: After spin numbers, the highest Attack item in hand becomes Unplayable until the next Spin. Tie is random. No Attack items: nothing. Longbow and Spiked Shield count. Boot and Poison Flask do not. Smoke is a new Spin, so it clears. Attack still works. Cannot be Defeated unless Quiet Bell has silenced me.
notes: Petrify tooltip: Unplayable until your next Spin.
review_note:
(Tier 2) At the start of combat, 'Petrifies' your Item with the highest ATK value

(Waits until after on-spin calculations are finished, then creates a 'stone petrification' texture/overlay on the item with the highest current ATK, making it Unplayable until the fight is over. A tooltip popup should appear when the user holds shift and is reading this ability to define 'Petrify' and explain this mechanic with, "Petrify - becomes Unplayable until your next Spin".

When calculating Atk to choose a target, formula count. If there's a tie, choose at random. If there are no items that deal atk damage, this ability does nothing. Any item that has Atk counts, including things like Longbow and Spiked SHield (but not things like Da Boot and Poison Flask)

name: Harpy
ability: I attack you when we meet, and after each item you use.
flow: On spin, one swing of my current Attack (Block works). After each item fully resolves, if I am still alive, one more swing. Ceases when you click Done or I am Defeated/Slain. Done still takes the normal hit. Not Attack = Block.
notes: One swing, fight stays open. If an item already killed me, no extra swing.
review_note: At the start of combat, and after the player uses any item, if the Harpy is not already defeated, it will immediately resolve combat by attacking the player. Only after the player clicks 'Done (Take X)' or Defeats/Slays the Harpy will this ability cease

name: Kobold Trapper
ability: I attack an extra time for each item you use this fight.
flow: On Done, swing count is 1 plus items used this fight. Cube feed does not count. Block is spent per swing.
notes: 0 items = 1 swing. 2 items = 3 swings.
review_note: (Tier 2) Attacks an additional time for each item you use during this fight.

name: Clockwork Knight
ability: If I live, I leave two Tier 2 owners in my place.
flow: If you do not Defeat or Slay me, I leave and two random Tier 2 owners sit immediately, even if that grows the wheel past 8. You are not in a new fight yet. Attack still uses owners left while I am on the wheel.
notes: Quiet Bell strips this: I leave like anyone else, no heirs.
review_note: (If the player does not Defeat or Slay this monster, it will remove itself from the dungeon and replace itself with 2 Tier 2 Monsters chosen randomly)

name: Basilisk
ability: I discard every item you use immediately while you face me.
flow: While you fight me, Keep does not work. Every item you use is discarded immediately. Knife nick, Lantern, and Breastplate leave your hand. Quiet Bell strips this.
notes: Keep after the fight is already over does not apply — the toss happens when you click.
review_note:
Slight rewording, but same ability,

"While facing me, all Items are discarded upon use immediately."

name: Twins
ability: Even Attack and even Block happen twice against me.
flow: While you fight me, an even Attack number hits me twice as two separate Attacks of that number. An even Block you gain while facing me is gained twice. Odd numbers happen once. Quiet Bell strips this.
notes: Anvil would take 1 from each of those two Attacks. Poison Flask is not an Attack.
review_note:
Change to 'Twins' and replace art with two twin or dopples)

Attack or Block values that are Even happen twice against me.

(Eg if the player uses a weapon that has 2 Attack, it 'attacks twice' and deals 4 total damage against this unit. Similarly, if the player blocks for 4, it will add 4 Block twice for 8 total block.

name: Beggar
ability: My Attack copies the Attack number on your leftmost Attack item. If you have none, my Attack is 3.
flow: My Attack is the live Attack number on your leftmost item that has an Attack number, after the usual hand sort, skipping cards with no Attack number. It updates on Spin and when you use an item. If you have no such item, my Attack is 3. Quiet Bell: printed Attack.
notes: Spent cards are skipped. Petrified cards have no Attack number for this.
review_note: Replaces its Attack to always equal to the current Attack value of the player's leftmost item (that has an Attack value). Updates this value upon Spin and Item use. If the player has zero such items, then its Attack returns to its base value of 3.

name: Wick
ability: I gain 1 Attack and lose 1 HP whenever you use an item.
flow: Whenever you use an item, every Wick on the wheel gains 1 Attack and loses 1 HP immediately, even if you are not facing them. A Wick at 0 HP is not removed until the fight you are in ends. If you are facing a Wick at 0 HP, they do not Attack; Done removes them as Slain. Cube feed is not an item use. Quiet Bell strips this.
notes: Kobold adds extra swings. I add to the Attack number. Both can stack if they ever sat together; they will not in one fight.
review_note:
Gains +1 Atk and loses 1 HP each time the player uses an item.

Health up0dates immediately upon Item use (regardless of who the player is actively facing), but if the unit drops to 0 HP they will not be Slain until after the current combat is Done

name: Anvil
ability: I cannot lose more than 1 HP from one source.
flow: I cannot lose more than 1 HP from one source. Attack, Poison Flask, and other HP loss each chip 1. Defeat still works. Two separate Attacks chip 1 twice. Quiet Bell strips this, so full Attack lands.
notes: Needleback poke is not an Item hitting me. Poison Flask is not an Attack. Extra Attacks each chip 1.
review_note:
I cannot lose more than 1 HP at a time (from any source).

(Can still be 'defeated', but effects like Poison Flask, Attack Damage, etc. can only reduce its HP by 1 at a time. Notably, things that trigger attacks multiple times would proc this ability twice, making the unit lose 2 total HP for example)
